name: HSM to Python
description: Checks the Python code of the diagram, generates its program and runs it on the HSM dispatcher. Needs the hsm-to-python commands (hsm-check, hsm-gencode, hsm-run) with the hsmd and CyberiadaML modules in the PATH of the editor.

parameters.label: State machine
parameters.description: The state machine to run; empty: the first one

parameters.label: Tick, ms
parameters.description: The period of the TIME_TICK event

actions.label: Check the code
actions.description: Lint the Python code of the states and the transitions

actions.label: Generate the program...
actions.description: Write the Python program of the diagram into the directory

actions.label: Run the diagram...
actions.description: Run the diagram on the dispatcher; the output goes to the Output tab
